Assistant Police Chief Jason Swaim of the Winston-Salem Police Department said officers responded after hearing gunshots on Saturday night. title: Gaza’s first winter storm floods tents as aid groups blame Israeli restrictions for ‘man-made catastrophe’
summary: LONDON: Salma woke in the dark to water seeping into her family’s tent from above and pooling beneath them. She had layered tarpaulins over the tent in Al-Mawasi, in southern Gaza’s Khan Younis, hoping to keep out the rain.
